title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1385: Special entrance (1)

section.p: More and more black holes appeared in front of the gate.

Grandstar City remained the same. Even now, many people were still paying close attention to this city. Before long, numerous experts covered in death qi gathered. These were the people entering the Luminous Domain Mansion from the ancient cities. There were forty of them. Some of them were mayors, and some were merely residents. These residents mainly came from the cities where the mayors did not want to enter personally.

Only five demonic beasts walked out of Grandstar City. They weren’t particularly strong. Or to be precise, they were rather weak. Two were Cloudbreaches and three were Mountainseas. All of them were trembling with fear. Too many eyes were on them. They hurriedly gathered with the other ancient city participants after leaving the city. Their fear was understandable. The eyes of numerous Invincibles were on them.

Even the eye in the white-haired divine king’s hand was paying close attention to these people. Outside the ancient cities, these Invincibles were able to easily see through them. Thus, they were able to see that none of them was Su Yu.

Even so, the order to kill them all had been issued. None of them would be spared. The ancient city participants would be targeted like the human participants. Su Yu was too big of a nuisance for them to risk anything.

Suddenly, Grandstar flew out from the city and landed in front of the ancient city participants. He coldly said, “Follow me. I will deliver you to the entrances. We can’t have others looking down on the holy cities.”

Once again, Liu Hong floated above the city. As he regarded the participants, he smiled and said, “Be careful, everyone. Those from the holy cities should try to stay united. If my guesses are right, a bunch of losers I defeated before will take this chance to vent their anger on you. They are helpless before me, but they can probably do a lot to you. Mayor Tian He, you’re the strongest in the group. If possible, try to take care of the others when you’re in the mansion.”
“I’ll do my best.”

Tian He was one of the few mayors who had decided to enter. He had been provoked into entering the mansion by Heavendoom’s constant comparison of him and Su Yu. Since Heavendoom disliked him so much, he had decided to take a break from Heavendoom.
Liu Hong said, “Best of luck, everyone.”
Then, he stopped talking and gazed at the entrances in silence. The speed with which new entrances were appearing started increasing. There were nine rows of them, with ninety entrances per row.

The higher the row, the easier it would be for one to reach a higher level of the mansion upon entering. As for the special entrance, they were located above the white-jade gate. The experts and geniuses of the major races were already standing in front of the entrances, waiting for the right time to enter. There were a lot of them.

The experts from the minor races aligned with the major races started stepping forth as well. To the east, the human participants stepped forth one after another. Humans and dragons made up the majority of the participants at the eastern entrances. The ancient city participants were also entering from the eastern entrances. Even those from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion were there.

Almost all the stronger experts would pick the entrances on the higher levels. This would save more time for them as these entrances would help them skip several levels in the mansion. As for the weak, they would mostly pick the entrances on the lower levels. It was likely that most of them would have to start their exploration from the first level of the mansion.

Suddenly, an expert spoke, “The Luminous Domain Mansion will not stay open for long. Each entrance can only be entered by one living being. When the person inside dies, the entrance will collapse. Upon leaving the mansion, you will find yourself outside the same entrance you entered from. There are no restrictions on killing inside the mansion. However, do try to restrain yourself since you are all fellow pillars of the Myriad Realms. Excessive bloodshed is never a good thing. There are many dangers waiting inside the mansion. Take care.”
“Token holders, select your entrances. You may enter after the special entrance appears.”
With that, even more token holders stepped forth. Some entrances were still left unclaimed. Nobody said anything about these unclaimed entrances.
These unclaimed entrances could be the entrances left for stronger experts or even Invincibles. They had merely refrained from showing themselves too early to avoid being targeted by everyone else.

For example, everyone knew that the humans would definitely send some Invincibles into the mansion. But who would those Invincibles be? At the moment, that was still unknown. These people would only step through the entrances when it was time to enter.
This was very important. For example, one could assume that Niu Baidao would be the one entering only to encounter Great Ming King inside. Such an error in judgment could prove fatal.

Of course, the various races would not allow too many Invincibles to enter. It was simply too risky. Losing too many Invincibles might threaten even the home realm of these races. The various races judged that humanity would send no more than five Invincibles into the mansion.

The more important human Invincibles would not be among them. For example, people like Great Qin King would not enter as that would weaken the defenses of the Human Realm. It was unlikely that these Invincibles would enter.
Far away.

Su Yu and the minor race members were also getting ready. Above the white-jade gate, a massive black hole was taking form. That was the special entrance. It had yet to fully stabilize. When it was stable, everyone could start entering.

Su Yu looked around, noticing many familiar faces waiting in front of the many entrances. Almost all the Heaven Index geniuses were present. Many of the Earth Index geniuses were present as well. He saw many familiar faces among the human participants.

He knew almost all of the twenty participants from Great Xia. The Liu City participants were not counted among the twenty. Most of the Great Xia participants were youngsters. Only a small number of them were from the older generations. The strongest Great Xia participant, also the leader of their group, was Administrator Hu.

Great Xia had lost too many experts recently. Administrator Hu might be advanced in age, but he was reliable and steadfast. Thus, he was a safe option to send. Su Yu even saw Chen Long, his father’s friend, among them. This wasn’t surprising.

In the army, Chen Long could already be considered a genius. He was someone who had climbed the ranks through sheer hard work. Su Yu could see that Chen Long had grown considerably since their last meeting. The Xia Family might have contributed slightly to this, helping him open more acupoints and cultivate a different foundation source art.

People like Xia Huyou and Wan Mingze were also among them. Huang Teng and Wu Qi, the top geniuses among the younger generation of Great Xia were there as well. Naturally, numerous people were paying close attention to these people.
There were also many familiar faces among the Great Ming participants. Among them was Bai Junsheng, standing there with a bitter and helpless expression.

Cui Lang was there as well. He kept a calm expression, but he also looked slightly uncomfortable since he was attracting too much attention. Eventually, he roared in frustration, “Stop looking at me! I’m really not Su Yu! If you doubt me, inspect me. I’m really not Su Yu!”
How terrifying. So many eyes were on him. He could feel all his hair standing on end.

Cui Lang felt extremely helpless. Seeing that everyone was still staring at him, he moved beside a woman and gave her a sudden kiss before saying, “This is my wife! Su Yu won’t have the courage to do this! You never covet the wife of a brother, am I right?”
Su Yu was stunned. What the hell was that? That woman was most likely the rumored daughter of Cheng Family. The beloved granddaughter of Old Man Cheng Mo, Cheng You.
Cui Lang sure was brazen to do something like this when so many people were looking.

Cheng Mo was present among the Great Tang participants. His face sank. He had opted to participate because he was already a ninth-stage Sunmoon, someone near the Pseudo Invincible Realm. He was entering to look for carrier treasures.

Her granddaughter had also received a slot due to her contributions in the Allheaven Battlefield. When he saw Cui Lang kissing his granddaughter in public, and when he saw the bashful expression on his granddaughter’s face, he felt like coughing blood from sheer anger.
“Cui Lang!”
Cheng Mo glared at Cui Lang. If glares could kill, Cui Lang would be dead by now.
Cui Lang merely flashed Cheng Mo and smile and said, “Grandpa Cheng, I have no choice. Everyone is eyeing me. I have to prove I’m not Su Yu or I’ll die in there!”
That left many people speechless.
Even Liu Hong couldn’t help but say, “I’m right here. What are you scared of? The myriad races clearly fear me. Should I be proud? Or should I feel helpless?”
Nobody said anything. Yes, they could see Su Yu in the city. But they couldn’t help but wonder if this wasn’t the real Su Yu. The Invincibles and Daofuse eyes never stopped searching for Su Yu.

At this point, everyone had agreed that it was unlikely for Su Yu to sneak into the mansion. Furthermore, the stone statues had been quite active. No regular mayor could withstand such a burden. However, they couldn’t stop feeling wary of Su Yu.

Or to be precise, they were too surprised. Su Yu was a troublemaker. How could a troublemaker like him not enter the mansion? Things wouldn’t feel right without him in there. Would someone so fearless give up on a chance to enter the mansion?

After Cui Lang proved that he wasn’t Su Yu, a lot of people stopped paying attention to him. In truth, many Invincibles had inspected him repeatedly before this. It didn’t matter if he was Su Yu anymore. The myriad races had decided to hunt down every human in the mansion.
Beside Su Yu, Langtu said, “Honestly, I’m surprised to hear that Mayor Su isn’t entering. This is too unexpected. It’s understandable why everyone is so wary.”

Su Yu didn’t know what to say. Was it really so unbelievable? Was everyone so sure he would enter? Since everyone was expecting him to enter, he shall do the opposite! Fine, fine. Who was he kidding? This wasn’t a temptation he could resist.

Just then, the large black hole above the white-jade gate started growing stable as the undulations on its surface started weakening. After taking a deep breath, Lang tu said, “It’s starting. Take care, everyone. Things will be the most dangerous right as you’re about to enter. This is the moment we have joined hands for.”
The act of entering the entrance would also be the most dangerous part of this journey.
Abruptly, an intense wave of source qi rippled over everyone. Almost at the same time, numerous figures shot forward.
“Die!”
Some were blasted apart right after soaring into the air.
As of this moment, everyone around them was a competitor. It was perfectly logical to eliminate some when there was a chance.

At the same time, more experts stepped forth from the encampments of the various major races. These were the experts who were attempting to enter without the slots. They were incredibly powerful. Very few people had the courage to get in their way.
These experts came from various races, including the immortals, divines, devils, and even humans. One after another, they soared into the sky.
One of them was a devil. With a casual punch, he blasted everyone ahead of him apart and said, “Get out of the way.”
Meanwhile, Langtu had an incomparably solemn expression as he said, “Rise and control your speed. Let the experts go first.”

With that, he led a group of roughly thirty Skysoars and Cloudbreaches into the sky. Similar groups could be seen everywhere. Tens of thousands of people could be seen in the sky. Even as they approached the entrances, even more people were arriving from all directions.
Meanwhile, the major race Invincibles merely watched on silently.
360 slots.

Each time, tens of thousands of people would fight over the 360 slots available through the special entrance. Each time, this was the part where the majority of the casualties would occur. After all, only 3,600 people would ultimately enter the mansion. The casualties inside the mansion wouldn’t surpass the casualties outside the mansion no matter what.

Things seemed to be a lot more intense this time. During one of the previous openings, tens of thousands of lives were lost. That was also the highest number of deaths ever recorded in an opening. At the time, more than a hundred thousand people had attempted to get through the special entrance.

All that for a chance to enter the mansion. A chance that those of the major races didn’t even need to fight for. Why? Because they monopolized the safe slots. This was the sorrow of minor races who were too weak to receive the safe slots. They could only gamble for an opportunity with their very lives.
